symptom: PC in VLAN 10 gets IP but cannot ping default gateway
topology_and_show_evidence: PC-A 192.168.10.21/24; gateway 192.168.10.1; Gi0/1 access VLAN 20; show vlan brief shows Gi0/1 in VLAN 20
expected_fault: Interface is assigned to wrong VLAN

symptom: PC gets IP but cannot reach server in another VLAN; gateway ping works
topology_and_show_evidence: PC 192.168.30.20/24; gateway 192.168.30.1 responds; show ip route lacks 192.168.40.0/24

symptom: Two PCs intermittently lose connectivity
topology_and_show_evidence: show arp contains 192.168.10.50 mapped to two different MAC addresses; both hosts configured with 192.168.10.50

symptom: PC can reach gateway but not external network
topology_and_show_evidence: PC 10.0.1.20/24; gateway 10.0.1.1; router show ip route has no default route

symptom: PC receives 169.254.x.x address
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip dhcp binding empty; router DHCP pool exists but excluded range includes all addresses; interface is up
expected_fault: DHCP pool has no usable addresses

symptom: PC receives IP but DNS name does not resolve
topology_and_show_evidence: ping 8.8.8.8 succeeds; nslookup server unreachable; show running-config has wrong DNS server 10.10.10.99

symptom: Trunk carries VLAN 10 but VLAN 30 hosts fail
topology_and_show_evidence: show interfaces trunk lists allowed VLANs 10,20; VLAN 30 is absent

symptom: Router interface cannot pass traffic after configuration
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip interface brief shows Gi0/0 administratively down

symptom: Hosts in VLAN 20 cannot communicate with each other
topology_and_show_evidence: show vlan brief shows VLAN 20 missing; switchports configured as access VLAN 20

symptom: Inter-VLAN routing fails for VLAN 30 only
topology_and_show_evidence: show interfaces trunk shows trunk native VLAN 99; switch native VLAN is 1

symptom: ACL blocks legitimate web traffic
topology_and_show_evidence: show access-lists 110 has deny tcp any host 10.0.0.10 eq 80 before permit statement
expected_fault: ACL rule order blocks HTTP traffic

symptom: Guest users can reach internal server
topology_and_show_evidence: show access-lists GUEST-IN permits ip any 10.0.0.0 0.0.255.255; guest VLAN 50

symptom: NAT users cannot reach Internet
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip nat translations empty; show run shows ip nat inside on WAN interface and ip nat outside on LAN interface

symptom: Only some private hosts get Internet access through NAT
topology_and_show_evidence: show access-lists NAT-ACL permits 192.168.10.0 but not 192.168.20.0; NAT overload references ACL

symptom: DHCP clients get wrong gateway
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip dhcp pool LAN default-router 192.168.20.254; SVI address is 192.168.20.1

symptom: Static route exists but traffic still fails
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip route 10.20.0.0/16 via 10.0.0.2; show ip interface brief shows next-hop interface down
expected_fault: Static route points to unreachable next hop

symptom: Wireless client connects to SSID but receives no address
topology_and_show_evidence: AP SSID maps to VLAN 60; switch trunk allowed VLANs 10,20,30 only
expected_fault: Wireless VLAN not permitted on trunk

symptom: Wireless guest can associate but cannot access Internet
topology_and_show_evidence: AP guest SSID uses VLAN 70; DHCP scope for VLAN 70 is missing
expected_fault: Missing DHCP scope for guest wireless VLAN

symptom: Server reachable by IP but not by hostname
topology_and_show_evidence: DNS A record points app.local to 10.10.10.25; server changed to 10.10.10.35

symptom: Router cannot form OSPF adjacency
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip ospf neighbor empty; show run interface Gi0/1 shows area 0; peer is configured for area 1

symptom: OSPF adjacency is up but remote LAN is missing
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip ospf neighbor FULL; show ip ospf interface has passive-interface on LAN-facing interface

symptom: PC can ping gateway but HTTPS server is unreachable
topology_and_show_evidence: show access-lists 120 denies tcp any host 10.10.20.10 eq 443

symptom: DHCP works on local VLAN but not remote VLAN
topology_and_show_evidence: remote SVI lacks ip helper-address; DHCP server is 10.1.1.10

symptom: Subnet hosts cannot communicate after mask change
topology_and_show_evidence: Host A /24; Host B /25; both configured in 192.168.10.0 range

symptom: Switch port shows err-disabled after connecting endpoint
topology_and_show_evidence: show interfaces status shows err-disabled; show errdisable recovery shows port-security violation

symptom: VLAN users lose connectivity after switch replacement
topology_and_show_evidence: show vlan brief on new switch lacks VLAN 40; trunk allows VLAN 40
expected_fault: Required VLAN missing on replacement switch

symptom: Internet works from router but not from LAN hosts
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip nat statistics shows no translations; LAN interface lacks ip nat inside
expected_fault: NAT inside role missing on LAN interface

symptom: PC has correct IP and gateway but cannot reach server
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip route contains destination route; show access-lists 101 has deny ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.20.10
expected_fault: ACL denies source subnet to server

symptom: DNS works for public names but internal hostname fails
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip dns server shows enabled; internal zone lacks A record for fileserver.corp

symptom: Router interface has correct IP but link remains down
topology_and_show_evidence: show ip interface brief shows Gi0/2 down/down; show interfaces Gi0/2 indicates no carrier
